shared_elements: incised/carved marks on a rock surface
single figural motif standing out from a field of marks (A: a figure in the upper area; B: a splayed figure)
justification: Both surfaces carry incised marks on rock, and each contains something that reads as a figure, but A is a dense, ruled multi-line field of repeated formal sign-shapes covering the whole panel while B is a single isolated splayed radiating figure on an otherwise blank ground. The manner of depiction differs completely: A uses regimented rows of carefully outlined conventional signs, B a loose schematic sketch with no ordering scheme or accompanying elements.
